Public BssMode enum derives Debug,Clone,Copy,PartialEq. Off,On,Auto are modes; comments describe floating-point intent, not local type enforcement. No Eq or Default derive.
Public to_sensitivity(&self)->f32 maps Off0.0,On1.0,Auto0.5 exactly; it does not inspect data or invoke an encoder.
Public parse(&str)->Option<Self> allocates a lowercase string and accepts only off,on,auto. No trimming: surrounding whitespace is invalid. Invalid input yields None, not an error or automatic Auto.

Public Debug+Clone+PartialEq CompressionParams contains public columns and types HashMap<String,CompressionFieldParams>. Keys are literal strings, not compiled patterns or Arrow type objects. HashMap iteration gives no configured wildcard priority.

Public Debug+Clone+PartialEq+Default CompressionFieldParams exposes optional rle_threshold:f64, compression:String, compression_level:i32, bss:BssMode, minichunk_size:i64. Default means all None. RLE docs give 0.0-1.0 and strict run_count<num_values*threshold; compression docs name lz4/zstd/none. No constructor validation rejects out-of-range/NaN thresholds, negative chunk sizes, unknown strings or level/scheme combinations here.
Public CompressionParams::new returns two empty maps, no default compression assignments or allocations for entries.

get_field_params borrows config, field name and DataType, creates default params, renders data_type.to_string() for exact type-key lookup and merges that record first. The exact display spelling matters. An exact columns key then merges and prevents the wildcard branch, even if the record has no Some fields.

Without an exact key, scan columns in HashMap iteration order, merge the first matching pattern and break. No sorting, specificity scoring or combination of several patterns. Overlapping wildcard results therefore have no stable precedence contract. Return owned merged record; input config is not mutated.
Default for CompressionParams forwards to new; both maps remain empty.

Public CompressionFieldParams::merge(&mut self,other:&Self) overwrites each field only when other has Some; compression String is cloned. None cannot clear inherited state. For example a scheme override with level=None retains a previously selected level. No cross-field or numeric validation occurs.

Private matches_pattern(name,pattern)->bool: exact * matches all; otherwise trailing * branch wins and uses literal prefix before one final star; otherwise leading * uses literal suffix after one first star; otherwise split at first embedded * and require prefix,suffix and name.len()>=pattern.len()-1; otherwise exact equality. Lengths are UTF-8 bytes. This is not a general glob: *foo* requires a literal *foo prefix; further stars remain literal. Empty expansion is possible; middle length guard prevents prefix/suffix overlap such as test_name matching test_*_name.

cfg(test) module and test_pattern_matching assert suffix, prefix, middle-star, universal and exact cases with positives/negatives. Tests include rejection of overlapping prefix/suffix in test_name. They do not cover multiple stars, Unicode, multiple matching map entries or trim behavior.

test_field_params_merge checks initial None for threshold,scheme,level,bss, then merges threshold0.3/lz4/On and a zstd/level3/Auto overlay with no threshold. It asserts retention of0.3 and replacement of the others; minichunk_size remains None in inputs but is not separately asserted.

test_get_field_params supplies Int32 default threshold0.5/lz4 and *_id override threshold0.3/zstd/level3. Float32 unmatched field stays unset, ordinary Int32 uses type defaults, and user_id Int32 uses the pattern. This tests only one wildcard candidate.

test_exact_match_priority gives *_id lz4 and exact user_id zstd, asserting zstd. No test in this file covers empty exact records suppressing wildcard defaults, BssMode parsing/sensitivity, malformed numeric values, inherited level mismatch or mini-chunk merge behavior. All tests were read, not executed.

ranges: SPDX/module docs; imports ArrayRef, deep_copy_array and debug/trace logging. No task spawn or IO dependency.

Public Debug AccumulationQueue has private cache_bytes:u64,keep_original_array:bool,buffered_arrays:Vec<ArrayRef>,current_bytes:u64,row_number:u64,num_rows:u64,column_index:u32. row_number records first input row; num_rows counts supplied top-level rows, not necessarily array length. column_index only labels logs.
Public new(cache_bytes,column_index,keep_original_array) initializes empty vector, zero byte/row counts and row_number=u64::MAX sentinel. No minimum capacity/size or column validation.

Public insert owns ArrayRef and accepts row_number,num_rows; returns Option<(Vec<ArrayRef>,u64,u64)>. If sentinel, set first row; add supplied row count and array.get_array_memory_size() as u64. Ordinary additions can overflow; no ordering, contiguity, length or count validation. A legitimate first row u64::MAX collides with the sentinel. Accounting precedes copying and reflects Arrow-reported memory, not a strict serialized-byte budget.

When current_bytes>cache_bytes (strict greater), log and append triggering array without copying even when keep_original_array=false. Save first-row/count, reset bytes/sentinel/rows, mem::take all arrays and return Some. Thus returned group includes the overshooting array; no array splitting or hard memory cap. Input order is preserved.

At or below budget, trace and either retain original handle or deep-copy through lance_arrow, then push and return None. No Result/rollback mechanism; a panic during copy occurs after counters changed. Contextual deep_copy_array builds from recursively copied ArrayData with preserved type,length,offset and nulls; its safety relies on valid input ArrayData, not validation in this queue. (rust/lance-arrow/src/deepcopy.rs:35-77)

Public flush returns None for empty buffer with trace and no state reset in that branch. Otherwise trace, save first row/count, reset bytes/sentinel/rows and take vector. Repeated successful drain then flush yields None. No automatic flush-on-drop, local tests, unsafe blocks, async lifecycle or locking. Structural FieldEncoder caller keeps rep/def builders separately and drains them with these arrays into do_flush; this queue does not encode or persist a page itself. (rust/lance-encoding/src/encodings/logical/primitive.rs:7976-8007)

ranges: SPDX/module comment explicitly distinguishes byte packing from bit packing; import Lance Error/Result. No file header or codec registration.
Public U8BytePacker with private Vec<u8> data; private with_capacity reserves requested bytes, private append pushes u8. These are wrappers, not externally callable constructors.
Public U16BytePacker has private Vec and private capacity*2 allocation without checked multiplication; append extends two little-endian bytes.
Public U32BytePacker uses capacity*4 and four LE bytes per append; no internal validation beyond input u32 type.
Public U64BytePacker uses capacity*8 and eight LE bytes. Allocation arithmetic may overflow or allocation may fail; constructors return Self rather than Result.

Public BytepackedIntegerEncoder variants U8/U16/U32/U64 own their packers; Zero carries no data/count. Smallest possible width in docs means width selected from caller-provided max, not actual values or arbitrary bit widths. No Debug/Clone derive.

Public with_capacity(capacity:usize,max_value:u64)->Self selects Zero for0, U8 through255, U16 through65535, U32 throughu32::MAX, U64 otherwise. Capacity is a reserve hint, not append limit. The original max and number of values are not retained.

Public append(value:u64)->Result<()> rejects values exceeding chosen U8/U16/U32 width with InvalidInput naming value and width before mutation. A value exceeding original max still succeeds if selected width can hold it. U64 accepts everyu64. Zero accepts even u64::MAX and records nothing. Successful path calls append_trusted then Ok; omission exception is explicitly tested.

Crate-visible append_trusted debug_asserts try_from success for U8/U16/U32 then casts to narrow integer. Release-mode invalid values can truncate; no runtime Result check. U64 appends directly; Zero no-ops. Caller must supply bounds when an index is enabled. Contextual full-zip writer selects max0 to suppress repetition index and still calls append_trusted, explaining why Zero discards arbitrary offsets. (rust/lance-encoding/src/encodings/logical/primitive.rs:6555-6607)
Public into_data consumes encoder and moves backing Vec, or returns empty Vec for Zero. No width, length, magic, checksum or terminator accompanies bytes; caller must know width/count externally.
Public ByteUnpacker<I:Iterator<Item=u8>> enum has only U8/U16/U32/U64 variants over the iterator; no Zero or count-bearing variant.

Public generic new<I:IntoIterator<IntoIter=T>>(data,size:usize)->impl Iterator<Item=u64> accepts sizes1,2,4,8, consumes data.into_iter, otherwise panics Invalid size. clippy allowance acknowledges new does not spell Self return. It does not check byte length divisibility. Passing size0 for Zero output is invalid even when empty.

Iterator impl Item=u64. next returns None only if first byte is absent; remaining1/3/7 bytes unwrap and panic on truncated final element after consuming its prefix. Multi-byte values use from_le_bytes. U8 simply widens. No explicit size_hint, exact-size/fused guarantee or framing count is added.

cfg(test) module test_bytepacked_integer_encoder covers all four widths, exact byte vectors and round-trip collect. Inputs: [50,20,30] width1; [500,200,300] width2; [500000,200000,300000] width4; [0x5000000000,0x2000000000,0x3000000000] width8. Full literal expected bytes preserved below.

test_bytepacked_integer_encoder_rejects_overflow loops U8/U16/U32 max+1, asserts error text contains width, then asserts Zero accepts u64::MAX and yields empty data. No invalid-size/truncated-stream, unchanged-state-on-error, release trusted-overflow or capacity overflow test here; no tests executed.

Imports ArrowNativeType, Lance Error/Result, FromStr, compressor/decompressor traits, require_block_payload, binary encoder/decoder, structural metadata helpers, LanceBuffer and DataBlock types. These dependencies do the typed-buffer and nested-layout work; this file does not own disk IO or page selection.

Public Debug+Clone+Copy+PartialEq CompressionConfig holds crate-visible scheme:CompressionScheme and level:Option<i32>. Public new stores unchecked values; scheme() and level() copy them. No legal-level validation or feature check on construction.

CompressionConfig::default is Lz4 with Some(0), regardless of compiled features. Public Debug+Clone+Copy+PartialEq CompressionScheme variants are None,Fsst,Zstd,Lz4. This config default differs from CompressedBufferEncoder::default.

TryFrom in each direction between runtime and pb21 schemes accepts Lz4 and Zstd only. Runtime None/Fsst and protobuf unspecified produce InvalidInput with Unsupported compression scheme and Debug value. Conversion is metadata legality, not feature availability or actual compression.

Display spells fsst,zstd,none,lz4. FromStr accepts only exact lowercase spellings, no trim or case normalization, returns InvalidInput Unknown compression scheme: {s} otherwise. Unlike BssMode::parse this parse returns Result.

Public BufferCompressor:Debug+Send+Sync requires compress/decompress borrowing input slice and mutable output Vec, returning Result<()>, and config()->CompressionConfig. Implementations below append output, but trait declaration alone contains no transactional/error rollback guarantee.

Private zstd module gated feature=zstd imports Cursor,Write,Mutex,OnceLock and zstd bulk/stream APIs. Its pub ZstdBufferCompressor is not reachable as a public path through the private module. Fields store requested i32 level and OnceLock<Result<Mutex<Compressor<static>>,String>>. Lazy compressor context is reused only on compression; comment explains avoiding decompression-context contention as historical rationale, not measured evidence here.

Debug exposes level only. new stores level and empty OnceLock. Private get_compressor initializes dependency Compressor::new once, maps success into Mutex and failure into String. Initialization error is cached permanently and later calls wrap it as Internal Failed to create zstd compressor; no retry/reset path. Compressor mutation is serialized by a lock in compress; get_compressor itself just returns a reference.

Private is_raw_stream_format: fewer than8 bytes returns true; otherwise LE firstu32 must equal0xFD2FB528 and byte4 &0x10 must equal0 to classify raw. Other inputs are length-prefixed. IMPORTANT source discrepancy: comment names bit3/fourth bit but literal0b0001_0000 tests bit4/fifth bit; document executed mask, not comment. No external RFC was fetched. This is heuristic discrimination, not a complete frame validator; a coincidental length prefix can match the heuristic.

Private length-prefixed decode reads8-byte LE uncompressedu64 length, casts to usize, resizes output from old length to old+declared, and calls zstd bulk decompress into appended slice. It ignores returned decompressed byte count and never truncates/checks equality. If library succeeds with fewer bytes, remaining initialized bytes stay zero. No local allocation cap, checked-add/cast, payload checksum or rollback. This helper is reached for >=8-byte inputs by dispatcher.

Zstd compress appends8-byte LE input length, reserves/resizes compress_bound bytes, lazily obtains cached context, locks with unwrap (poison can panic), compresses into tail, maps codec failure to Internal Zstd compression error, then truncates to actual compressed size. On earlier error output retains prefix/resized tail; it is not restored. Level is not independently validated before dependency construction.

Zstd decompress accepts empty input as successful no-op. Raw-classified input uses copy_decode(Cursor,output); otherwise length-prefixed helper. Errors propagate; output may be partially appended. config always returns Zstd with Some(requested level), so requested None becomes runtime Some(0) through factory. Closing braces end feature module.

Private lz4 module feature gate and Debug+Default empty Lz4BufferCompressor. compress remembers existing output length, asks compress_bound, resizes by max_size+4, and calls block compress_to_buffer with modeNone and prepend_size=true. Success truncates to actual bytes; errors become Internal LZ4 compression error after mutation. No compression level is consumed.

LZ4 decompress rejects input shorter than4 with Internal LZ4 compressed data too short before mutation. Reads LEu32 declared length from first4, resizes appended region, calls decompress_to_buffer(input,None,tail), maps error to Internal LZ4 decompression error, and truncates to returned count. Unlike Zstd it uses returned count, but does not locally assert equality with declared size. No allocation cap or rollback. config returns Lz4,None regardless of input configuration.

Public Debug+Default empty NoopBufferCompressor; both compress/decompress append input bytes and return Ok. config returns None scheme and absent level. This is a working buffer copier, but runtime None cannot be converted to structural General metadata.

Public empty GeneralBufferCompressor namespace factory get_compressor(config)->Result<Box<dyn BufferCompressor>>: Fsst returns InvalidInput because FSST has its own path; Zstd returns feature-gated lazy context at level.unwrap_or(0), otherwise explicit package-not-built error; Lz4 returns feature-gated default ignoring level, otherwise matching error; None returns Noop. Factory success for Zstd does not prove later context initialization succeeds.

Public Debug GeneralBlockDecompressor stores private boxed inner BlockDecompressor and BufferCompressor. try_new constructs outer codec or propagates error. Trait decompress requires Some payload, decompresses into fresh Vec, wraps LanceBuffer and delegates inner with unchanged num_values. Empty Some is distinct from absent payload; missing payload yields InvalidInput {codec} requires one payload via helper. No local type/count validation, offset IO or streaming. (rust/lance-encoding/src/compression.rs:951-953)

Public Debug CompressedBufferEncoder has crate-visible boxed compressor plus private selected block_compression. Keeping selected config preserves optional level presence even if runtime defaults/ignores it. Default selects Zstd Some(0) when enabled, else Lz4 None, else None None, constructs factory with unwrap. No numeric format-version gate. All-features-off default can copy buffers but structural wrapped metadata later rejects None.

Public try_new config constructs runtime compressor and preserves original selected config. Public from_scheme(pb21 scheme) validates Lz4/Zstd conversion, sets levelSome(0) and calls factory; does not preserve an absent descriptor level because no level argument exists.

Public per_value_compress<T:ArrowNativeType> starts returned offsets with T::from_usize(0).unwrap, iterates input offset windows, casts each to usize, slices data[start..end], appends each compressed value to caller Vec and appends total compressed.len() converted to T with unwrap. Preconditions: valid monotone in-bounds offsets and representable output positions. Empty offsets still return onezero, one offset also onezero. For nonempty prefilled output Vec, first offset is0 but later offsets include preexisting bytes: caller must supply empty destination for ordinary self-contained encoding. On later error earlier appends remain.

Public per_value_decompress mirrors compression with independent slices and cumulative output offsets; same unchecked offset slicing, unwrap conversion, empty-input offsets and prefilled-output caveats. Neither helper verifies starting offset0, final offset==data.len, number of values, signedness or row count; generic ArrowNativeType is broader than actual u32/u64 callers.

PerValueCompressor impl requires VariableWidth DataBlock or Internal naming data type. Supports bits_per_offset32/64 using typed LanceBuffer borrow; other widths unreachable panic. Uses fresh output Vec and returns Variable PerValueDataBlock with same width/count and new BlockInfo. Descriptor wraps runtime compressor.config around Variable(flat offset-width,None values). Thus runtime-normalized level is used here, unlike whole-block selected config. TODO says support setting level, but actual config path can carry selected Zstd level; record TODO separately from executed construction. Wrapped descriptor can fail after compression (e.g. None codec). No null/type/count validation or whole-page assembly here.

VariablePerValueDecompressor impl allocates data.len()*2 hint, handles32/64 offsets only, invokes helper, returns VariableWidth DataBlock preserving width/count and resetting BlockInfo. Hint is not decompressed size cap; arithmetic and conversions unchecked. Requires previously separated compressed per-value offsets; no whole-block header parsing.

BlockCompressor impl accepts FixedWidth (raw data plus Flat(bits_per_value,None)) or VariableWidth (VariableEncoder::default compress, require returned Some payload or Internal); other variants InvalidInput Unsupported data block type. Compresses encoded buffer, returns Some even if empty, wraps using preserved block_compression. None/Fsst cannot produce legal General descriptor; FSST factory already fails, None may perform work before wrapped rejects it. No direct stable/unstable version dispatch here.

BlockDecompressor impl on CompressedBufferEncoder requires payload, decompresses outer codec, then always uses BinaryBlockDecompressor::default with unchanged num_values. It is a variable-block convenience decoder, not symmetric decoding for the same type entire FixedWidth/VariableWidth encoder surface. GeneralBlockDecompressor is the descriptor-driven composition point; strategy constructs its inner recursively. (rust/lance-encoding/src/compression.rs:1213-1231)

cfg(test) module imports ZstdBufferCompressor unconditionally inside tests even though zstd implementation module is feature-gated. Source indicates a no-zstd test-build resolution risk; no feature build was run. test_compression_scheme_from_str checks none,zstd only; invalid test checks unknown string error, not exact variant/message or uppercase/whitespace.
Feature-gated zstd test compresses Hello, world! using length-prefixed writer then auto-dispatch decode, asserting bytes equal. It does not assert raw frame or prefix literal.

Zstd multiple-times test reuses one compressor, appends Hello and World into one output, records compressed boundary, decodes each separate slice into one output, checks total length and both slices. This is append behavior with caller-kept boundaries, not proof that one decode handles concatenated length-prefixed frames.

Raw-stream compatibility test creates dependency zstd::Encoder without length prefix, writes Hello, world!, finishes and feeds public dispatch decode. Test name/comment says length-prefixed, but actual dispatcher recognizes raw input. It asserts round-trip compatibility, not heuristic collision or reserved-bit correctness.

Feature-gated lz4 tests import Arrow types/datagen, metadata and harness helpers. Basic LZ4 round-trip asserts Hello, world! only. No short-input/malformed-length/nonempty-output/error-rollback assertions in this test.

Async rstest matrix: Utf8,LargeUtf8,Binary,LargeBinary times StructuralU16/U32/Sparse times slicing false/true =24 parameter combinations before harness cases. Field metadata requests lz4, dict divisor100000 and size ratio0.0001 to discourage dictionary, and fullzip; page size1MiB. Harness expectation is literal zstd despite lz4 metadata/test name, an unresolved source inconsistency rather than proof requested codec was used. Providers generate compressible compressme-prefix+counter values with correct large flag; other type panic. Delegates to check_round_trip_encoding_generated. Complete harness/selection semantics remain pending; tests were not run.
